# Research Engineer router

Clarify the decision and freshness requirement. Route broad current evidence to `deep-web-research`, repository maturity to `github-deep-dive`, extension discovery to `extension-discovery`, and decision output to `research-brief`. Prefer primary sources and label confidence.

Do not substitute academic-paper search for practical ecosystem research. Exit with an evidence plan and source priority.
